status: phase 5 of docs/CAST-CONSOLIDATION.md, the last: the stories, the guide, the directories, the Studio lists and the docs name exactly these 25 (the eleven retired keep only drawings for history, avatars/cast.js RETIRED_RECIPES); the report is docs/CAST-CONSOLIDATION-REPORT.md

core.name: Nils
core.role: the player; Swedish chief engineer of the Minato Maru; married to Thuan

core.name: Thuan
core.role: owns and runs Sakura Shōten outright: purchasing, accounts, stock, shop and supply; Nils’s wife; sister of Thao and Nhung

core.name: Thao
core.role: runs Minato Izakaya; Chin’s wife and Vy’s mother; the middle sister

core.name: Chin
core.role: motorman aboard the Minato Maru; mechanical repairman at the workshop with Tetsu when ashore; Thao’s husband and Vy’s father

core.name: Vy
core.role: Thao and Chin’s daughter; a pupil at the island school

core.name: Nhung
core.role: the island doctor (the owner, 22 October 2026: the clinic doctor’s look and post are hers, Dr Ken retired into her): surgery at the town hall clinic weekdays and Saturday mornings, house calls, on call at night; prints the town’s small paper in the evenings at the back bench of the old Front-Row shop; Sakura’s Sunday clerk; the eldest sister; Koji’s wife and Riku’s mother

core.name: Koji
core.role: fisherman and the bosun’s relief; drives Sakura Trading’s round in his kei truck on his weeks ashore, paid by the round (Higa Liquor’s until it closed, 22 October 2026); Nhung’s husband and Riku’s father

core.name: Riku
core.role: Nhung and Koji’s son; a pupil at the island school; Vy’s cousin

core.name: Yui
core.role: the island’s schoolteacher; Gran Higa’s granddaughter; helps at the bathhouse after school and at weekends

core.name: Gran Higa
core.role: owns Umi-no-yu and keeps it by day; her liquor shop is shut, its trade Sakura’s (the owner, 22 October 2026); the family’s ties in town

core.name: Tetsu
core.role: electrician; workshop partner of Chin; maintains the ship’s electrical equipment, the bathhouse’s plant and the island’s electrical systems

core.name: Aki
core.role: owns Sato Ramen, which keeps its name; stays ashore

core.name: Mori
core.role: the island’s police officer; the desk and the night patrol; his accommodation moves into the police station to come (addendum 1), koban staying his home id

core.name: Emi
core.role: keeps the dessert counter (Nakamura Zenzai and Blue Coral) and the community kitchen; Mai’s mother

core.name: Mai
core.role: Emi’s daughter; a pupil at the island school; Vy’s best friend

core.name: Fuji
core.role: master of the Minato Maru; sober on watch, the shed and the beer only after he signs off; lives aboard Shiosai

core.name: Jack
core.role: harbour agent: berth communications, freight and Minato’s shore-side mooring; an American former merchant seaman, long settled here

core.name: Mac
core.role: relief engineer of the Minato Maru; an older American engineer, an established island resident; a shore home and a separate duty berth

core.name: Nao
core.role: bosun of the Minato Maru; a shore home and a credible relief rota with Koji

core.name: Mika
core.role: port clerk: passenger tickets, parcels and the postal counter, all at the Port Terminal; keeps the coin laundry on the side, its morning round before the mailbag (the owner, 21 October 2026)

supporting.name: Ryo
supporting.role: chief officer of the Minato Maru: the lookout, access and the ramp; from Itoman, six years on the Kerama ferries before her

supporting.name: Ren
supporting.role: deck hand: the forward mooring station, the gangway and passenger-deck rounds; from Nago, his first ship

supporting.name: Aya
supporting.role: the sailing purser: the passenger count, the vehicle deck and the lobby; came from the Kume line for the short crossings

supporting.name: Jun
supporting.role: cook-steward: the crew’s meals, the galley and the kiosk; twenty years in the galleys of the cargo boats out of Naha

supporting.name: Kai
supporting.role: the Kitano shore line hand: the shore eyes at the Kitano berth every call; rents the Shiroma house across the lane from the pier

quarters.what: the relief engineer’s separate duty berth
the chief officer’s cabin aboard (FERRY_GA mate-cabin)

the crew accommodation aboard: the deckhand’s cabin (Ren) and the crew cabin; the crew cabin is drawn with one two-tier bunk, the bosun’s week-on berth and the relief engineer’s duty berth, so the purser’s and the cook’s berths are two more bunks for the docks-and-boats job
the Shiroma house on Kitano-jima, rented from the Shiromas in Naha: its gate on the hamlet lane, a bed, a table and a door, 25 m from the pier (phase 2 inspected it)
